snippet.title: Club Penguin Zero Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Club Penguin Zero is finally here! Join the fastest growing Club Penguin server to date with over 10,000 penguins already signed up!

"Waddle" you waiting for? Join the fun over at https://play.cpzero.net/ today!

Play now! - https://play.cpzero.net/
